# clavis secrets rm

<p class="cli-lead">Delete a secret (soft delete, history kept)</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis secrets rm KEY [flags]
```

</div>

Delete a secret. It is a soft delete: history is kept and the key can be restored from the web app.

## Examples

```sh
clavis secrets rm OLD_KEY --yes
```
